{{Top|leg}}
A '''projectile cannon''' was a weapon in common use during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Exocron Airfleet]] armed their [[Skylark]] [[skyfighter]]s with projectile cannons, as well as their larger Airfleet vessels. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the weapons were considered to be archaic.
